title: Add Request.path_for and relative URL resolution alongside Request.url_for
summary: Adds Request.path_for(name, **path_params) and URLPath.make_relative_url() so Starlette templates and reverse-proxied apps can generate root-relative paths without hardcoding or leaking internal upstream host authorities.
audit_note: Issue remains OPEN with 0 open PRs; 2 historical PR ref(s) by @pyritewolf (#75), @pamelafox (#293) - safe to build on and credit prior findings

title: Fix ZStream.groupedWithin hang on infinite streams with filtered empty chunks (series/1.x)
summary: Fixes ZStream.groupedWithin hanging on series/1.x when an infinite upstream emits empty chunks after filtering and the timer schedule fires with buffered elements.
audit_note: Issue remains OPEN with 0 open PRs; 3 historical PR ref(s) by @DenisKusakin (#8873), @DenisKusakin (#9113), @argofowl (#10917) - safe to build on and credit prior findings

title: Optional Recursive Lifespan Event Dispatching Across Mounted Sub-Applications
summary: Adds opt-in propagate_lifespan support to Router and Mount so mounted Starlette sub-applications enter and exit their async lifespan contexts cleanly inside an AsyncExitStack.
